text: Hello everyone, welcome to my class.Today we are going to deal with the writing section.At the end of this period, you are expected to grasp the structure and language features of a narrative essay and write a narrative essay that shares a story about providing first aid, make comments based on the checklist, and make modifications accordingly, have a deeper understanding of the significance of first aid to disaster prevention.First, look at the two pictures.What do you think the boy on the right is suffering from?What is Heimlich maneuver?You are right.The boy is suffering from choking, and Heimlich maneuver is a way to help the choking victim.Known as the embrace of life, Heimlich maneuver has been widely used all over the world, saving countless lives.It was developed in the 1970s by Henry Heimlich.Now read the article and try to summarize its main idea.You will have the next one minute for the task.Thank you for watching.Time's up, what's our summary?Right, the reading article tells the story of a high school student named Chen Wei used the Heimlich maneuver to save a person's life.The article not only describes the process of his rescue of a choking victim, but also introduces the history and operation of Heimlich first aid.Let's come to the next task.Read the article and then put A to E in the correct places in the text.One minute for the task.Ready?Three minutes for the task.Time's up, have you finished?Let's check the answers together.The first one is C.Chen wasted no time, which means Chen took action immediately.She got up and ran to Zhang's table at once.The second one is A.You should have only four minutes before the claps.It's a very short time, just leaving no time for the ambulance to arrive.The next one is B.First, call the emergency service.Then, make sure that the victim is really choking.Next comes E, which involves a small child.The last one is D.Then it comes, so you cannot just stand by and do nothing.The sentences you choose are the first sentence of each paragraph, whose function is to indicate the main idea of each paragraph.After reading the whole passage, we know that this passage can be divided into three parts.Paragraph 1 and 2 deals with a first aid story.Paragraph 3 to 5 involve Heimlich maneuver.The last paragraph gives comments.I believe this passage can help us understand how to write a narrative essay.A narrative essay tells a story.Like all good stories, it has three parts.The setup tells you about who, what and where.The conflict always involves a challenge or difficulty that the characters face.The conclusion is the end of the story, where the problem in part 2 has been solved.Now let's reread the article and then answer the questions below.You will have the next minute for the task.Can you answer these questions?Who were the people involved?They are Chen Wei, a high school student in Beijing, and Zhang Tao, a fellow diner at a restaurant.What happened?Zhang Tao was choking on some steak while eating.Where did it happen?Yes, it happened at a restaurant.What did Chen Wei do?Excellent job!Chen Wei performed Heimlich maneuver on Zhang Tao.How does the story end?Chen Wei saved Zhang Tao.Then the ambulance came, and the doctors checked Zhang Tao and said he was fine.Now think about this question.What purpose does the quote at the end of the essay serve?Let's read it together.Chen later said about the incident.How could I justify sitting there and doing nothing?We are all humans, and we all have a responsibility to look after one another's welfare.What purpose does the quote serve?It provides a good way to wrap up the story.It also tells the reader about Chen Wei's emotions and opinions, and gives unique insight into his character.So when you write your own essay, you can try using a quote at the end to make your writing more impressive.Now let's read the article again for some useful language.Please underline the language describing actions.You will have one minute for the task.As for the language to introduce the emergency, we can findChoke on some steak.Hold his throat with his face turning red.Help his desperate friend to his feet.When it comes to the language to perform harmonic maneuver, we can locate the phrases.Make sure that the victim is really choking.Stand behind him.Wrap your arms around his waist.Make a fist.Place it in the upper part of his stomach.Grab your fist with your other hand tightly.Push up and into his stomach in one motion.Continue doing this until the obstruction is first out.What about the language to perform first aid on children?We can also find them in the passage.Lay the child face down on your lap, with the head lower than the rest of his body.Give first slaps to his upper back until he can breathe again.Here comes your writing activity today.Use what you have learned to write a narrative essay that shares a story about providing first aid.When you write, you can follow the steps.First, recall your experiences of giving first aid in an emergency.If you have never had any experiences, share stories you have read or heard about, or think up a situation.Write an outline of the three parts in your story, then think of a quote to sum things up.Write your narrative essay.Here is a chart to help you brainstorm and decide the content.You can write down some keywords to answer the questions in the chart.Two minutes for this task.Now it's time for your writing.Use what you have learned to write a narrative essay.Use what you have learned to write a narrative essay about providing first aid.After you finish your writing, you can use this checklist to revise your draft.Is the narrative essay clear?Does it have three parts?Does the first part tell you about who, what, and where?Does the second part show a conflict?Does the third part gives the conclusion?Is there a good quote to sum things up?Are the details of the story easy to understand?Here is the sample essay.The set-up and conflict is clearly written in the first paragraph with the necessary elements who, where, and what.Then what's the process?Right, he quickly jumped from his chair and ran over and picked her up.He held her in his lap, but Jiang was still struggling with a frightened look.She was not crying or making a sound.What an emergency!Then he carefully opened her mouth and gave her a few hard slaps.What's the end of the story?At last, a small button fell from her mouth onto the floor.Jiang was breathing once again.Jiang was saved.The writer also used a quote to give the comments.When seconds count, he said, an ambulance is often minutes away.So we'd better be equipped with some first aid techniques.They might work in some emergency.Here is your assignment today.Polish your story with the help of the checklist.So much for today.Great time with all of you.See you next time.
